程序包 com.ta.recruitment.model

类 User

java.lang.Object
com.ta.recruitment.model.User
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable
public class User extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a system user (TA, MO, or Admin).

Role values: "ta", "mo", "admin". Status values: "active", "inactive". The modules and pendingModules fields are MO-only and store semicolon-separated "courseCode|courseName" pairs.

    • User

      public User(String id, String name, String email, String password, String role)
      Creates a fully initialised User with status defaulting to "active".
      参数:
      id - unique user ID (e.g. "u1")
      name - display name
      email - login email (used as username)
      password - plaintext password
      role - one of "ta", "mo", "admin"
